9to5Mac Daily records a new episode every weekday. Subscribe to our show on Apple Podcasts or your favorite podcast player to make sure new episodes are delivered to you the moment they go live.

Stories covered in this episode:

  • watchOS 27.2 beta 2 restores app switcher with new gesture
  • Apple reportedly developing screen-less Whoop-like fitness tracker
  • What's going on with GM's CarPlay strategy (or lack thereof)?
  • Apple retires Apple Park Visitor Center's unique AR experience
